    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.121.20...0.122.0">0.122.0</a> (2026-08-04)</h2>
<h3>⚠ BREAKING CHANGES</h3>
<ul>
<li>drop Node.js 20 support (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10260" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10260/hovercard">#10260</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> keep the Shai-Hulud compromised versions unreachable (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10301" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10301/hovercard">#10301</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/db2a0665648b49dde742c4d027bef92f221930f4">db2a066</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> patch undici in code-scan-action and guard both lockfiles (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10278" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10278/hovercard">#10278</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/15bf41f2dcb7187fc6ed40cddea96b609b2610a9">15bf41f</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> pin socket.io-parser above the packet-decoder DoS (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10279" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10279/hovercard">#10279</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/d0f2a83d8b72f3c0ad71950e2822d9350b7a48ed">d0f2a83</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> repair Biome and undici upgrade regressions (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10292" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10292/hovercard">#10292</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/3565a3c1ffc16fd9f9a8d65ae93e4a6885c4b5c1">3565a3c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> restore XML entity decoding for xlsx test files (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10249" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10249/hovercard">#10249</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/00cdeb9a857ab019f61789b69ef75c3c852ce283">00cdeb9</a>)</li>
